note: Tracking stays on supremeautoparts.co.ke (Rock 2026-10-17): our server fetches status from the courier and renders it on the order page and in emails. No customer redirect to courier sites. All endpoints verified live 2026-10-17; none require auth; all fetched server-side.

fargo.name: Fargo Courier (Wells Fargo)

status_fetch.parse: Extract 'Waybill Status : <status>' and the Waybill Event Tracking rows (event + timestamp). Verified live with a test waybill showing 'Delivered' and event lines.

fargo.notes: The public track-your-shipment page itself iframes portal.fargocourier.co.ke/track; we call the portal URL directly and parse the HTML. No JSON API found - scraping is brittle to their template changes, add a fallback that shows courier name + tracking number if parsing yields nothing.

g4s.name: G4S Kenya Courier

status_fetch.parse: messageType=Error -> show 'not found'; otherwise response carries waybill detail/status. Verified live: dummy number returns {"message":"Waybill Detail Unavailable","messageType":"Error"}.

g4s.notes: SecureKey is public - it ships in G4S's own portal JS (g4s-portal.logixplatform.com/js/secureKey.js).

speedaf.name: Speedaf Kenya

status_fetch.parse: data[0].tracks[] holds scan events. Verified live: dummy number returns success:true with empty tracks.

speedaf.notes: Same public endpoints their own site uses.

out_of_scope_couriers: Easy Coach, ENA Coach, Guardian, SGA - excluded from checkout build per Rock 2026-10-17 10:26.
